shortBulletSummary: US inflation (CPI/PPI) surged, triggering a broad crypto market selloff.
Nearly $1 billion in crypto positions were liquidated as Ethereum (ETH) prices fell.
Citi integrated Bitcoin custody; Thailand launched spot BTC/ETH ETFs.
Crypto Fear & Greed Index is at 63 ("Greed") amidst market volatility.
Rising oil prices & geopolitical tensions add pressure on crypto markets.
